mentions.name: Fallax
mentions.description: Fallax is a phishing simulation platform for companies. Instead of sending simulated phishing emails, it injects them directly into mailboxes via the Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace API, so no allowlisting in spam filters is needed and tests aren't silently blocked. Results feed into compliance platforms like Vanta and Drata as security training evidence.
mentions.problem: Most phishing simulation tools send emails that get blocked by spam filters or require allowlisting, so tests can silently fail to reach employees.
